name: SSO-CN / RCN Rijksdatacenterfaciliteit Bonaire
notes: Highberg datacenter-strategy report for the Dutch government states that Caribbean Netherlands currently has two modern datacenters, including a small recently modernized SSO-CN facility on Bonaire running central departmental systems. The report says it is full, not Tier III, and is part of the existing stretched twin setup on Bonaire.

name: Flamingo TV datacenter Bonaire
notes: Highberg/Dutch-government strategy report identifies Flamingo TV's Bonaire datacenter as the second modern but small facility used by RCN for redundancy; it is private, not publicly owned, and lacks physical rack/room separation.

name: Caribbean Netherlands upper-windward government twin datacenter - Sint Eustatius candidate
developer: Dutch government / Rijksdienst Caribisch Nederland / local public bodies
notes: Official strategy recommends a twin-datacenter approach: one datacenter on Bonaire and a second hurricane-resistant location on Sint Eustatius or Saba for both upper-windward islands, later linked to a Dutch government datacenter in European Netherlands. The report works out an architecture using Bonaire and Sint Eustatius because Sint Eustatius appears more suitable on paper, but says further site investigation is needed.

name: Caribbean Netherlands upper-windward government twin datacenter - Saba alternative candidate
developer: Dutch government / Rijksdienst Caribisch Nederland / local public bodies
notes: Official strategy describes the second Caribbean Netherlands twin datacenter as being on Sint Eustatius or Saba; the Saba option remains a candidate pending further investigation. Current Saba public-body IT is described as limited server racks/rooms with minimal facilities and no full failover location, not a full datacenter.
